snippet": "Perfect catch — that error means Termux doesn’t yet have execute permission for the script file.
Here’s the quick, no-nonsense fix 👇

🧩 1️⃣ Move to where you saved the script
If you saved it in your Termux home folder:
bashCopy codecd ~

If it’s in Downloads (shared storage):
bashCopy codecd /sdcard/Download

🧩 2️⃣ Grant execute permission
bashCopy codechmod +x Rebuild_MetaBlooms_Archive.sh

You can confirm:
bashCopy codels -l Rebuild_MetaBlooms_Archive.sh

✅ You should see something like:
